interpretation_definitions.materially_worse: context source_target_only_evidence_membership_rate at least 0.10 below baseline; both rates must be non-null
interpretation_definitions.null_rule: A null rate is neither pass nor failure and cannot satisfy or trigger any interpretation predicate.
interpretation_definitions.reporting_caveat: Every interpretation includes supporting candidate counts/rates and states that all cells are single unreplicated samples under unpinned decoding.

interpretations: baseline fails while schema and prompt cells pass: unstated constraint/affordance dominates
only schema passes: schema naming/description dominates
only prompt passes: prose instruction dominates
combined passes while one or both single-factor cells fail: prompt/schema interaction matters
combined fails: the recommended joint configuration is not yet conformant and must not be promoted
baseline passes: original behavior may be stochastic; no prompt change justified without a separately frozen replication
context materially worse than baseline on source/target-only evidence membership: context complexity is a separate contributor
